name: Research Projects in AI Systems (Cache Replacement & Quantum Compilation)
overview: AI Research in Systems and Quantum Computing
short-description: Conducted research applying machine learning and generative AI to systems optimization and quantum circuit synthesis, developing experimental frameworks, datasets, and evaluation pipelines.

projects.name: Generative AI for Cache Replacement
projects.description: Designed an LLM-in-the-loop evolutionary framework to automatically generate and optimize cache replacement policies. Reproduced and benchmarked classical and state-of-the-art policies (LRU, SHiP, Hawkeye, RRIP) on SPEC-like workloads under strict metadata constraints. Engineered prompt strategies and iterative tuning methods to improve policy diversity and performance. Conducted ablation studies and performance analysis to identify high-efficiency cache replacement strategies.

projects.name: AI and Machine Learning for Quantum Compilation
projects.description: Developed an ML-driven pipeline to generate optimized block-encoding quantum circuits from operator matrices. Built an automated dataset generation system for large-scale operator–circuit training data. Integrated a circuit verification system into the training loop to ensure correctness and penalize invalid outputs. Designed quantum-aware optimization metrics, including circuit volume minimization, to outperform heuristic-based synthesis approaches.
